description: The stable refusal vocabulary for Offline Shared Workspaces. Every server-side refusal on an Offline path names one of these codes, and a new refusal path ADDS one here rather than inventing a string at a call site. Codes are lower_snake_case to match AUB's existing house style (`{"reason":{"code":...,"message":...}}` inside a PocketBase API error), and they travel unchanged to AUC and AUP so a modal is chosen by code and worded by locale rather than by matching on server prose. A refusal is NOT an incident: these are expected, correct outcomes of a rule, and reporting them to the incident backend would drown the signal that something is actually broken.

reasons.summary: No workspace with this id is visible to the caller.
reasons.remedy: A private workspace the caller is not a member of is reported as absent rather than as forbidden, so that workspace existence is not a probe.

reasons.summary: The workspace metadata revision in the request is not the current one.
reasons.remedy: Reload the workspace and reapply the change.

reasons.summary: A private workspace cannot become public while private assets are attached.
reasons.remedy: The refusal lists the blocking asset ids. Make each public, or detach it, then retry.

reasons.summary: max_members cannot be set below the current membership count.
reasons.remedy: Remove members first, or choose a limit at or above the current count.

reasons.summary: max_members exceeds the platform's own hard bound, which an Overlord cannot raise.
reasons.remedy: Choose a value within the platform limit reported in the refusal.

reasons.summary: The workspace holds an asset that is being edited Offline or is in a linked Real-time session.
reasons.remedy: The refusal lists the active assets. Retry when that work ends.

reasons.summary: The workspace owner cannot leave their own workspace.
reasons.remedy: Keep the workspace or delete it. V1 has no ownership transfer.

reasons.summary: The description contains a link with a scheme the product does not render.
reasons.remedy: Use http or https. javascript: and data: are refused.

reasons.summary: The caller is not a member of this workspace.
reasons.remedy: Accept an invitation, or join if the workspace is public and has room.

reasons.summary: The caller's workspace role does not hold the capability this operation requires.
reasons.remedy: The refusal names the required capability and the roles that hold it, so the sentence shown to the user is read out of the table rather than written beside it. A member below that role is offered the role-upgrade path.

reasons.summary: The public workspace is at its member limit.
reasons.remedy: The capacity check is atomic, so exactly one of two simultaneous joins at the last slot succeeds and the other sees this.

reasons.summary: This account is already a member; a second device or tab is not a second membership.
reasons.remedy: Open the workspace normally.

reasons.summary: The member holds an active Offline lease, or owns an asset pinned as a dependency of active work.
reasons.remedy: The refusal names the assets and sessions. Retry when that work ends. V1 has no force-kick that discards another user's unsaved work.

reasons.summary: A demotion would remove asset.edit from a member who is editing right now.
reasons.remedy: Retry when the lease is released or expires. Blocking is preferred to mid-edit revocation.

reasons.summary: The workspace owner cannot be demoted or removed through ordinary membership operations.
reasons.remedy: None in V1. Exactly one owner, always holding Overlord capability.

reasons.summary: No invitation matches this token.
reasons.remedy: Nothing about the workspace is disclosed alongside this refusal.

reasons.summary: The invitation passed its expiry.
reasons.remedy: Ask the Overlord for a new invitation.

reasons.summary: Invitations are single-use; this one has been accepted.
reasons.remedy: If the membership exists, open the workspace; otherwise ask for a new invitation.

reasons.summary: The Overlord revoked this invitation.
reasons.remedy: Ask the Overlord.

reasons.summary: The invitation is bound to a different account than the one that opened it.
reasons.remedy: Sign in as the invited account. Nothing about the workspace is disclosed.

reasons.summary: An invitation cannot assign the Overlord role.
reasons.remedy: Invite as Lord, Knight or Pilgrim. The assigned role is stored server-side and is never read from a URL.

reasons.summary: This member already has a pending role request for this scope.
reasons.remedy: Wait for the Overlord, or withdraw the pending request.

reasons.summary: The request has already been approved, denied, withdrawn or expired.
reasons.remedy: Reload the request list.

reasons.summary: Workspace ownership cannot be requested through the role-upgrade mechanism.
reasons.remedy: None. Ownership is not a role grant.

reasons.summary: The optional message exceeds the contract's bound.
reasons.remedy: Shorten it. This is request metadata, not chat.

reasons.summary: No asset with this id is visible to the caller.
reasons.remedy: Reload the workspace.

reasons.summary: An asset belongs to at most one Shared Workspace and this one is already attached elsewhere.
reasons.remedy: Detach it from the other workspace first. The other workspace is named ONLY when the caller can already see it; otherwise the refusal says the asset is shared elsewhere and nothing more, because naming it would leak private workspace metadata.

reasons.summary: The asset is not attached to this workspace.
reasons.remedy: Reload the workspace.

reasons.summary: A public workspace may contain only public assets.
reasons.remedy: Make the asset public, then attach it. There is no bypass for copy or recovery flows.

reasons.summary: An attached asset cannot be made private while its workspace is public.
reasons.remedy: Ask the Overlord to detach it, or make the workspace private first.

reasons.summary: An asset attached to a workspace cannot be deleted by its owner through the ordinary delete path.
reasons.remedy: Ask the Overlord to detach it, or leave the workspace, which detaches every asset the leaver owns. Account erasure is a separate lifecycle and is not blocked by this.

reasons.summary: The asset is being edited Offline, is in a linked Real-time session, or is a pinned dependency of one.
reasons.remedy: Retry when that work ends. V1 prefers blocking to force-removal of an in-use dependency.

reasons.summary: This asset type has no Offline edit lease because it has no in-place edit path.
reasons.remedy: Upload a replacement as a new asset.

reasons.summary: Only a map escalates into a Real-time session in V1.
reasons.remedy: None. There is no whole-workspace session and no live editing of texture or package assets.

reasons.summary: The dependency set of an active edit or session is pinned, and this change would invalidate a map somebody is working in.
reasons.remedy: Retry when the edit or session ends. A newly uploaded asset enters a map's dependency closure on the next controlled reopen, never underneath an open one.

reasons.summary: A participant cannot read a required non-platform dependency of this map.
reasons.remedy: The refusal names the dependency. A session never starts where participants have structurally different asset access.

reasons.summary: A dependency the manifest names no longer resolves.
reasons.remedy: The map remains, explicitly incomplete. Where the dependency is essential to parsing rather than to rendering, the load fails rather than degrading silently.

reasons.summary: The ASSET OWNER's account cannot currently accept writes. The saver's own quota is not consulted, and is not charged.
reasons.remedy: Save a copy to your own account and contribute that copy. Ownership is never transferred silently and the charge is never moved to the editor.

reasons.summary: The write would put the ASSET OWNER over their storage allowance.
reasons.remedy: Same recovery: copy to your own account. The owner may also free space.

reasons.summary: expected_revision is not the asset's current revision. The write is refused; nothing is merged and nothing is overwritten.
reasons.remedy: The local copy is never discarded on the client's behalf. Offer `Save a copy to My Maps`, and let the user choose.

reasons.summary: Another member holds the exclusive Offline lease on this asset.
reasons.remedy: The refusal names the incumbent. An eligible editor is offered the Real-time escalation request; the second client never receives editable state.

reasons.summary: The SAME account already holds this lease from another browser or device.
reasons.remedy: Close the other editor. One account is one collaborator, so this never becomes a Real-time invitation to oneself, and V1 has no lease takeover between a user's own devices.

reasons.summary: The operation requires a lease the caller does not hold.
reasons.remedy: Acquire the lease, if the asset is free.

reasons.summary: The lease lapsed after the inactivity timeout and the caller no longer owns the asset.
reasons.remedy: A returning client must revalidate rather than assume. If nobody took the asset and its revision has not moved, the lease can be reacquired; if it moved, the local work can only be saved as a copy.

reasons.summary: The caller's role does not hold asset.edit, so it cannot take an editable lease.
reasons.remedy: Request a role upgrade. Real-time is not a permission bypass.

reasons.summary: The same requester asked about the same asset too recently.
reasons.remedy: Wait out the interval named in the refusal. This exists so a blocked user cannot spam an incumbent's notifications.

reasons.summary: This requester already has a pending request for this asset.
reasons.remedy: Wait for the incumbent to answer, or cancel.

reasons.summary: The request was already accepted, declined, cancelled, superseded or expired.
reasons.remedy: Reload.

reasons.summary: The request passed its expiry before the incumbent answered.
reasons.remedy: Ask again if the asset is still held.

reasons.summary: Only the member holding the valid Offline lease may accept, and the lease must still be valid at the moment of acceptance.
reasons.remedy: No session is created from stale authority. Both participants are told to refresh.

reasons.summary: A user cannot ask themselves to escalate, including from a second device.
reasons.remedy: Close the other editor instead.

reasons.summary: The map is already in a linked Real-time session; a second session is never created for one map.
reasons.remedy: Join the existing session through the ordinary Real-time join rules.

reasons.summary: The flush, the CAS, the quota check, the dependency resolution or the AUC session creation failed, so no session exists.
reasons.remedy: The map returns to a truthful Offline or idle state rather than to a phantom lock, and the exact failing step is reported. This is the one reason in this file that is ALSO an incident, because it is a component failing rather than a rule refusing.

reasons.summary: No such thread in this workspace.
reasons.remedy: Reload.

reasons.summary: The caller may not edit or delete this message, or may not resolve this thread.
reasons.remedy: Knight may create and reply and may not resolve; Pilgrim reads only.

reasons.summary: The message exceeds the contract's bound.
reasons.remedy: Shorten it.

reasons.summary: This idempotency key was already used for a request with a different payload.
reasons.remedy: A retry of the same request replays the original outcome; a different request needs a different key.

reasons.summary: The request declares a contract version this server does not implement.
reasons.remedy: The refusal names the versions the server accepts. A client is never silently reinterpreted under different rules.
